primary_user_goal: Quickly resume listening or discover something new to play
primary_business_goal: Maximize engagement and listening time through personalized recommendations
copy_summary: Personalized greeting based on time of day ('Good morning', 'Good afternoon', 'Good evening'). Grid of 6 recent items for quick access. Horizontal carousels of personalized content: 'Made For You', 'Your top mixes', 'Recently played', 'Popular playlists'. Each card shows album art prominently with title below.
notes: Exceptional visual hierarchy with album art as the hero element. The time-based greeting creates a personal touch. Quick access grid at top prioritizes resume functionality - understanding that users often want to continue where they left off. Dark theme reduces eye strain for extended listening sessions. The horizontal carousels enable content density while maintaining scannability. Each section has a clear 'See all' affordance for deeper exploration.

primary_user_goal: Find specific content or browse by genre/mood
primary_business_goal: Help users discover new content and increase catalog exploration
copy_summary: Large search bar at top with placeholder 'What do you want to listen to?'. Recent searches displayed as pills below search. Grid of colorful genre/mood cards: Pop, Hip-Hop, Rock, Indie, Workout, Chill, Focus, Party, etc. Each card has distinctive color and small illustrative image.
notes: The search screen doubles as a browse screen - brilliant design that serves both intent-based and exploratory users. Category cards use bold, distinct colors making them instantly recognizable and scannable. Camera icon enables searching by scanning codes or images. Recent searches provide quick access to repeat queries. The conversational search placeholder feels inviting rather than clinical.

primary_user_goal: Find and select the specific song, artist, album, or playlist desired
primary_business_goal: Minimize friction between search and playback
copy_summary: Active search bar with query. Filter tabs: All, Songs, Artists, Albums, Playlists, Podcasts. 'Top result' card prominently displayed. Categorized results below: Songs list with album art thumbnails, artist photo, and explicit content badge where applicable.
notes: The 'Top result' card is an excellent pattern - algorithmically determines the most likely desired result and promotes it visually. Filter tabs enable quick content type switching without new search. Real-time search results provide instant feedback. Explicit content badges (E) are subtle but visible. Each result row has clear tap targets. The hierarchy moves from most likely match to categorized alternatives.

primary_user_goal: View album details and play/save tracks
primary_business_goal: Drive album saves, follows, and complete listens
copy_summary: Large album art as hero image with gradient fade to dark background. Album title, artist name (clickable), and metadata (year, song count, duration). Green 'Play' button and 'Shuffle' button. Heart icon to save. Three-dot menu for additional options. Track list below with number, title, explicit badge, and duration.
notes: The album art hero treatment is Spotify's signature pattern - makes the artwork the emotional centerpiece. Gradient fade creates smooth transition to track list. Green play button stands out against dark UI and album colors. Heart icon placement allows easy saving. Artist name is clickable for easy navigation. The track list is clean and scannable. Sticky header on scroll keeps play controls accessible.

primary_user_goal: Browse playlist contents, play, and optionally collaborate or share
primary_business_goal: Encourage playlist saves, follows, and sharing to expand reach
copy_summary: Playlist cover mosaic or custom image as hero. Playlist title, creator name, follower count, and description. Like count and save indicator. Track listing shows album art thumbnail, song title, artist, and explicit badges. Option to add songs if user-owned playlist.
notes: Playlist view mirrors album view for consistency but adds social proof (follower count) and collaborative features. Mosaic cover art is auto-generated from track artwork when no custom image is set. Description field enables playlist curation context. User-owned playlists show edit affordances. Social proof of likes/follows encourages saves. The familiar pattern reduces learning curve from album navigation.

primary_user_goal: Control playback, view current track details, and access queue
primary_business_goal: Maximize listening session duration and engagement
copy_summary: Full-screen album art dominates view. Song title and artist name below artwork. Progress bar with elapsed/remaining time. Large playback controls: shuffle, previous, play/pause, next, repeat. Like button to save track. Bottom row: device picker, share, queue. Lyrics button when available.
notes: The now playing screen is immersive and focused. Album art takes center stage as the emotional anchor. Controls are familiar and generously sized. Progress bar enables scrubbing. Device picker (Spotify Connect) is the killer feature for cross-device experience. Swipe down to dismiss is intuitive. Lyrics integration adds value without cluttering interface. The shuffle and repeat states have clear visual indicators.

primary_user_goal: Access saved music, playlists, and podcasts
primary_business_goal: Encourage library building and return visits
copy_summary: Filter chips at top: Playlists, Artists, Albums, Podcasts. Sort/filter icon and layout toggle (list/grid). List of saved items showing cover art, title, type indicator, and download status. 'Liked Songs' playlist pinned at top. Recently played items surfaced.
notes: Library redesign (2023) added filter chips for quick content type switching. Grid/list toggle accommodates different user preferences. Downloaded content indicators help users identify offline-available music. 'Liked Songs' auto-playlist is prominently pinned. Recent additions surfaced to encourage continued saving. Search within library enables quick access to large collections. The library serves as the user's personalized music collection.

primary_user_goal: Explore artist's catalog, follow, and discover related content
primary_business_goal: Drive artist follows and complete catalog exploration
copy_summary: Large artist photo as hero image. Artist name with verified badge if applicable. Monthly listener count as social proof. Follow button and shuffle play. Sections: Popular tracks (top 5), Discography (albums, singles, compilations), 'Featuring [Artist]' playlists, 'Fans also like', 'About' with bio.
notes: Artist pages are comprehensive discovery hubs. Monthly listener count provides social proof and context. Popular tracks highlight algorithmically-determined hits. Discography section enables complete catalog exploration. 'Fans also like' powers artist discovery flywheel. About section with bio, photos, and links personalizes the artist. Verified badge builds trust. The page structure enables both casual browsing and deep exploration.

primary_user_goal: Discover new music tailored to personal taste
primary_business_goal: Demonstrate personalization value and increase platform stickiness
copy_summary: Distinctive Discover Weekly cover art with user's profile image integrated. 'Made for [Username]' subtitle. Refreshes every Monday message. 30 recommended tracks. Description explains the personalization: 'Your weekly mixtape of fresh music. Enjoy new music and deep cuts picked for you.'
notes: Discover Weekly is Spotify's flagship personalization feature. The user's profile image on the cover creates ownership and emotional connection. Weekly refresh creates anticipation and habitual return. Track selections balance familiar artists with new discoveries. The 'Made for [Username]' framing emphasizes the personalized nature. This feature demonstrates algorithmic value and increases platform lock-in. Save functionality enables keeping liked discoveries.

primary_user_goal: Monitor and control playback while browsing other content
primary_business_goal: Keep users engaged with playback while enabling continued exploration
copy_summary: Compact bar above bottom navigation showing: small album art thumbnail, song title (marquee if long), artist name, device indicator, like button, play/pause button. Progress indicator as thin line at top of bar. Tap to expand to full player.
notes: The mini player is essential for the 'background listening' use case. Users can browse, search, and manage library while music plays. Quick like button enables saving without interrupting flow. Device indicator shows where music is playing (Spotify Connect). Progress line provides ambient awareness of track position. Tap to expand is intuitive. The mini player never blocks navigation, maintaining app utility during playback.
